title: RUSH LLMOutput v1.2
$comment: v1.2: adds policy_citations and policy_quotes (provenance for the labeler's policy-grounded justification). v1.1 added cold-start GenAI labels (gen_ai, not_gen_ai) alongside warm-start violative/non_violative labels, and prepared_image_* audit fields for the downsampled JPEG actually sent to the provider (see pipeline/labeling/image_prep.py).

justification.description: Policy-grounded argument. The v1.2 prompt caps justification at ~350 tokens (~1500 chars); longer responses still validate but get flagged in the run record as justification_too_long.

policy_citations.description: Policy node ids the labeler invoked (e.g. GA.surface_texture.plastic_skin). Empty when label=abstain.

policy_quotes.description: Verbatim short snippets lifted from the supplied policy markdown.

justification_too_long.description: Server-set flag (not labeler-set): true when justification exceeds the policy-grounded cap (~350 tokens / ~1500 chars).

is_boundary_between.description: Optional boundary pair: exactly two L1 class ids when is_boundary=true for ontologies that require a pair (for example MNIST digit boundaries).

boundary_between_invalid.description: Server-set audit flag: true when a required is_boundary_between pair was malformed or outside the ontology's L1 classes.

prepared_image_sha256.description: SHA256 of the downsampled JPEG bytes actually sent to the provider.

prepared_image_width.description: Pixel width of the downsampled JPEG.

prepared_image_height.description: Pixel height of the downsampled JPEG.

prepared_image_mime_type.description: MIME type of the downsampled bytes (typically image/jpeg).

prepared_image_byte_size.description: Byte length of the downsampled JPEG payload.

latency_ms.description: Wall-clock provider round-trip latency for this call in milliseconds (runner-measured response.latency_ms). Persisted so X3 can build per-model speed telemetry; do NOT drop from this schema (guarded by test).
